repeat test dicing cycles with adjusted parameters and continue iteratively optimizing for best results
monitor dicing process parameters and equipment performance during operation continuously
record dicing process data (parameters used, yield results, cycle time, blade wear indicators) in designated formats (e.g., logs, electronic records)
analyze recorded data to identify trends, potential areas for further optimization, and opportunities for preventive maintenance (based on blade wear data)
